lead_independence.lead: A body was recovered from deep within the mangroves near the House of Refuge in Martin County on Tuesday. Martin County Sheriff John Budensiek said a Good Samaritan found a wallet Saturday belonging to Michael Anthony Debevec. In an attempt to return the wallet, the Good Samaritan went to Debevec's home, which ultimately led his family to file a missing person report.
